skill.name: pricing
skill.description: Develop pricing, packaging, value metrics, research plans, price increases, and pricing page audits for SaaS and other business models.

content.value_statement: Pricing decisions often lack clear evidence, customer alignment, and coherent packaging. This skill turns business context and research into practical pricing recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Collects business, market, performance, and growth context before recommending pricing.
Evaluates per-seat, usage-based, feature-based, transaction, and flat-fee value metrics.
Designs differentiated pricing tiers for customer personas and enterprise requirements.
Plans Van Westendorp, MaxDiff, willingness-to-pay, and usage-value research.
Assesses price increase signals and recommends rollout approaches.
Audits pricing pages across human buyer experience and AI-agent readability.
limitations: Does not collect survey responses, usage data, or competitor pricing automatically.
Recommendations depend on the accuracy and completeness of the supplied business context.
Live pricing page audits require page text or access through a browsing-capable tool.
Does not implement structured data, conversion experiments, or billing system changes.

use_cases.title: Launch Initial SaaS Pricing
use_cases.description: Define a value metric, tier structure, and research plan for a new software product.

use_cases.title: Repackage a Growing Product
use_cases.description: Align features, limits, support, and enterprise options with distinct customer segments.

use_cases.title: Audit Pricing Page Clarity
use_cases.description: Score pricing transparency, plan differentiation, buyer trust, and AI-agent readability.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Current Pricing
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current pricing for [product]. Customers are [audience], plans cost [prices], and my main goal is [goal].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing pricing model

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Value Metric
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare suitable value metrics for [product]. Consider customer outcomes, usage patterns, predictability, scalability, and resistance to gaming.
prompt_templates.scenario: Selecting what the business should charge for

prompt_templates.title: Design Pricing Tiers
prompt_templates.prompt: Design three pricing tiers for [product] using these personas, features, usage limits, support needs, and willingness-to-pay evidence: [details].
prompt_templates.scenario: Creating differentiated packages for several segments

prompt_templates.title: Build a Research and Rollout Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pricing research and rollout plan for changing [current model] to [proposed model]. Include methods, segments, decision criteria, risks, and validation steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced pricing change with evidence and implementation planning

output_examples.input: Recommend a pricing metric for a team analytics product whose value grows with active users.
output: Primary metric: active users per month.
Reason: team adoption increases customer value while remaining easy to understand.
Validation: compare retention and expansion across active-user bands before setting thresholds.

output_examples.input: Create three tiers for a project management product serving freelancers, small teams, and larger companies.
output: Starter: core planning tools with low project and user limits.
Team: collaboration, integrations, and higher limits for growing groups.
Business: advanced controls, security, onboarding, and dedicated support.

output_examples.input: Audit a pricing page where prices appear only in images and plan limits are unclear.
output_examples.output: The main gap is pricing transparency and machine readability. Publish prices and plan limits as text, then add clear per-tier descriptions.

best_practices: Provide customer segments, current prices, conversion, churn, and revenue goals before requesting recommendations.
Validate price points with customer research and observed behavior before a broad rollout.
State each tier's audience, included value, limits, and upgrade trigger in clear language.
anti_patterns: Do not set prices only from delivery cost or competitor averages.
Do not create tiers with unclear differences or arbitrary feature gates.
Do not treat benchmark conversion rates as guaranteed results for every market.

faq.question: Can this skill choose an exact price?
faq.answer: It can recommend a range and decision framework. Exact prices require reliable customer, market, and performance evidence.

faq.question: Does it support non-SaaS businesses?
faq.answer: Yes. It can address marketplaces, e-commerce, and services when you provide the relevant value drivers and buying process.

faq.question: What research methods does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Van Westendorp, MaxDiff, Gabor-Granger, conjoint analysis, and usage-value correlation.

faq.question: Can it compare freemium and free trials?
faq.answer: Yes. It evaluates market size, product adoption, onboarding needs, conversion goals, and service costs.

faq.question: Can it audit a live pricing page?
faq.answer: Yes, when page text or browsing access is available. It scores buyer clarity and AI-agent readability.

faq.question: Does it implement pricing changes?
faq.answer: No. It produces strategy and recommendations, while billing, experiments, structured data, and page changes require implementation tools.
